title: 第23章 侍女柘月第24章 豫州之地
slug: 北侯世子反派的我背景逆天
lines: 雾气氤氲，笼罩着那座破庙，残垣断壁在晨雾中若隐若现，爬满墙壁的藤蔓，像是岁月镌刻的痕迹。
此刻，武老已经将赵岚送走，然后又回到了破庙之中。
“走吧，先出去再说。”
裴苏等人一起踏出了破庙。
入眼便是姜岁柠跟那老妇人紧紧挨着的模样，裴苏不由得哂笑。
“我说这位婆婆，难道是要随我们一同回帝京？”
老妇人没有理会，只是对着姜岁柠低声道：“殿下，我便走了。”
姜岁柠轻轻点头，也放开了老妇人的手，眼眸若最纯净的秋水，不染丝毫杂质。
裴苏就这样静静地看着姜岁柠与老妇人分别，直到老妇人的身影飞越丛林，彻底消失在众人的视线之中。
此刻，极远的天边泛起鱼肚白，夜幕将散，旭日将升。
曙光如银纱轻披于郊野之上，破庙在晨雾中若隐若现，残垣断壁上爬满了藤蔓。
青砖红瓦之旁，一个身披淡金披风的少女眺望远处。
仿佛是第一缕阳光撒在她的发梢，泛起微微色彩。
姜岁柠就这样眺望许久，直到再也瞧不见灵婆婆的半分影子。
感受到身后似乎有着若有若无的目光扫视，她没来由的心慌了一下。
从今天起，若无意外，她便是要一直跟着那位北侯世子……
还有灵婆婆说的什么……什么世子妃，简直……
一想到这些，姜岁柠便心乱如麻，不敢跟接触裴苏的目光，一直保持着背身的姿态。
“我说……公主殿下，你还要在那看多久？”
直到裴苏的声音幽幽响起，姜岁柠才迅速转身，微微低眸。
“北侯世子，我们现在去哪？”
裴苏没有说话，还是就这样看着姜岁柠，笑道——
“不急，回帝京之前，总得理理我们之间的关系，难不成，我一直喊你公主殿下，或是叫你姜小姐？”
姜岁柠愣了愣。
她倒是没想过这个问题，裴苏一提起，倒也是这样。
她的确是公主，但却是前朝公主，如今的大晋自有大晋朝的公主。
还有“姜”这个姓氏，虽不至于是禁忌，但也是一个少有人提及的话题，若有人知晓她姓姜，难免会有所怀疑。
“那……”姜岁柠试探出声，“我用化名？”
裴苏皱着眉，思考良久。
“这样吧，回到裴国公府后，你便在暂且先在我身边做个侍女，掩人耳目，可行？”
裴苏说完这话，身旁的半夏张了张嘴，眼里露出促狭之色。
殿下这是……蓄谋已久啊！
让一朝公主做个侍女，恐怕天底下也只有殿下能干得出来这种事。
怪不得，要等那老妇人走后才说，否则不敢想象，那位老妇人会怒极到何种地步。
“如何？”
裴苏见姜岁柠依旧呆呆愣在原地，又淡淡逼迫了一声。
姜岁柠不知如何回答，她从未当过侍女，而且，这与灵婆婆跟她说的好像有些不一样……
不知怎的，或许是心头莫名痒臊，姜岁柠竟直接道：
“可是，灵婆婆跟我说，你想让我做你的世子妃。”
此话一出，所有人都齐齐沉默，就连裴苏也定格了那么一下。
他本是算准了姜岁柠心思单纯、不与人计较、不会反驳，便想叫她当个侍女玩玩。

The mist shrouded the ruined temple, and the ruins of the walls were looming in the morning mist. The vines climbing all over the walls looked like traces engraved by time.
At this moment, Mr. Wu had sent Zhao Lan away and then returned to the ruined temple.
"Let's go out first."
Pei Su and others stepped out of the ruined temple together.
What caught his eye was Jiang Suining and the old woman standing next to each other, and Pei Su couldn't help but smile.
"I said, does this mother-in-law want to go back to the Imperial Capital with us?"
The old woman ignored him and just whispered to Jiang Suining: "Your Highness, I'm leaving."
Jiang Suining nodded lightly and let go of the old woman's hand. Her eyes were like the purest autumn water, without any impurities.
Pei Su quietly watched Jiang Suining and the old woman say goodbye until the old woman's figure flew over the jungle and completely disappeared from everyone's sight.
At this moment, the far horizon is filled with fish belly white, the night is about to disperse, and the sun is about to rise.
The dawn is like a silver gauze draped over the countryside, the ruined temple is looming in the morning mist, and the ruins are covered with vines.
Beside the green bricks and red tiles, a girl wearing a light gold cloak looked into the distance.
It was as if the first ray of sunlight was shining on her hair, giving it a slight color.
Jiang Suining stared like this for a long time, until she could no longer see the shadow of Granny Ling.
She felt a vague glance behind her, and she felt flustered for no reason.
From today on, if nothing unexpected happens, she will always follow the Northern Marquis Crown Prince...
And what Grandma Ling said...the Crown Princess, it's just...
When Jiang Suining thought of this, she became so upset that she didn't dare to meet Pei Su's eyes and kept her back turned.
"I said... Your Highness, how long are you going to watch there?"
It wasn't until Pei Su's voice sounded faintly that Jiang Suining quickly turned around and lowered his eyes slightly.
"Prince Beihou, where are we going now?"
Pei Su didn't say anything, but just looked at Jiang Suining and said with a smile——
"There's no rush. Before returning to the Imperial Capital, we have to sort out our relationship. Is it possible that I keep calling you Princess, or Miss Jiang?"
Jiang Suining was stunned.
She had never thought about this issue, but it was the same when Pei Su mentioned it.
She is indeed a princess, but she is a princess from the previous dynasty. Today's Jin Dynasty has its own princess from the Jin Dynasty.
There is also the surname "Jiang". Although it is not taboo, it is also a topic rarely mentioned. If anyone knows that her surname is Jiang, they will inevitably be suspicious.
"Then..." Jiang Suining said tentatively, "Should I use a pseudonym?"
Pei Su frowned and thought for a long time.
"Let's do it this way. After you return to Duke Pei's mansion, you can be a maid by my side for the time being to cover up others' eyes. Is that okay?"
After Pei Su said this, Banxia beside him opened his mouth, with a narrow look in his eyes.
Your Highness, this has been planned for a long time!
Let Princess Yichao be a maid, I am afraid that only Your Highness in the world can do such a thing.
No wonder he had to wait until the old woman left before speaking. Otherwise, I can’t imagine how angry the old woman would be.
"How?"
Seeing Jiang Suining still standing there, Pei Su faintly forced him.
Jiang Suining didn't know how to answer. She had never been a maid, and this seemed to be a little different from what Granny Ling told her...
Somehow, maybe because of the inexplicable itch in her heart, Jiang Suining said directly:
"But Granny Ling told me that you want me to be your Crown Princess."
As soon as these words came out, everyone fell silent, even Pei Su froze for a moment.
He was sure that Jiang Suining was simple-minded, would not care about others, and would not refute, so he wanted to ask her to be a maid for fun.
